description: Cancels one of the caller's offers on a single XP listing -- 'pull my offer', 'cancel my bid'. An open offer resting across events is cancelled with cancel_my_open_offer. offer_uuid is the offer's bid_uuid or its buyer swap id. confirm=false returns a preview; confirm=true cancels it, and only that call returns success=true. Requires sign-in and the write:bids scope.

confirm.description: Required. True to rescind; False to preview without rescinding.

identifier.description: Public listing identifier the offer was placed on.

offer_uuid.description: Identifier of the offer to cancel. Preferred: the offer's bid_uuid. Also accepted: its buyer swap identifier — MCP resolves it via privy-bids/mine.

name: cancel_my_offer
title: Cancel My Offer
